title: Blog Post to Podcast
summary: Approve one outline and script, and get your post back as a podcast episode two AI hosts talk through, with intro music, a transcript, show notes, a LinkedIn post and an optional 45-second clip.
outcome: Turn a post or newsletter into a podcast episode people can follow by ear: two AI hosts talk it through, with intro music, show notes, a LinkedIn post and a short clip. You approve the script before anything is spent.
boundary: It doesn't publish anything, host a podcast feed or post to LinkedIn; add facts the post doesn't contain; get past paywalls or logins; narrate a post you may not use; or spend anything before you approve the outline, script, voices and maximum cost. The clip is made only when your computer can draw captions.

catalog_tools.purpose: Record the approved script as a two-host conversation, a voice per turn, or in one voice (the expressive model, used by default).
Record a one-voice episode or reading for about half the price when the user picks the fast model.
Make the music for the 5-second intro and outro sting.

inputs: Your post: a public link, pasted text or a file (required)
Format: a two-host conversation of about 4–7 minutes (default), one host, a 2-minute brief, or the post read as written
Voices: a matched pair for a conversation, Eric and Jessica (default) or Warm and Lily, one voice for a solo episode, or your own picks from ElevenLabs' voice library by voice ID
Focus: who your listeners are, or what to dwell on or skip (default: taken from the post)
Show name for the intro and show notes (default: the blog or newsletter name)
outputs: episode.mp3: an episode about your post that a listener can follow in one listen, with a 5-second intro and outro sting and no music under the speech
transcript.md: the approved script with speakers and timestamps
show-notes.md: a summary, the episode's points, what else the post covers, the link to the post and a note that the voices are AI
linkedin-post.md: a LinkedIn post ready to paste
clip-45s.mp4: an optional 45-second captioned clip, made only when your computer can render it

cost.model: Speech is charged per character and the intro music per minute, at the prices Scrollport shows just before the quote. Writing the script, joining, loudness, the transcript, show notes, LinkedIn post and clip happen on your computer at no cost.
cost.notes: At list prices inspected on 14 October 2026 (expressive voice $0.14 per 1,000 characters, fast voice $0.07, music $0.21 per minute), 90 seconds of speech plans to about $0.20 and five minutes to about $0.60; the approved maximum adds a re-take of the longest part. Eleven v3 has settled at about 22% of its list price, so a five-minute episode typically costs about $0.12 to $0.15 (the 14 October verification episode, 5:01, cost $0.12), and a saved intro sting needs no new music. Trial-safe: a two-minute brief (at most 1,900 characters of speech and one 7-second music request) stays within $0.60, re-take included.

approvals: Approve the outline, script, voices and maximum cost, shown together in one message, before any paid run; the approval time is recorded before the first run
Hear the opening and say it sounds right before the rest is recorded; with no answer, the run stops and waits
Approve again after any change to the script, voices, model or length, and before any spend above the approved maximum
Approve in your Scrollport wallet any run that Scrollport holds for confirmation
compatibility: Agent Skills host with local files; ships in the OpenAI plugin, because Anthropic's plugin directory excludes audio generation
One Scrollport connection (CLI, MCP or HTTP) that can search, inspect, run and read the wallet
ffmpeg and ffprobe to join the parts, trim the music and set loudness; without them the parts are returned in order
An ffmpeg build with the subtitles and showwaves filters and libx264 for the optional clip
